name: MehulK Workstation & Sonoma Suite
description: MehulK's personal workstation suite: a macOS Sonoma lock screen with live video, GIF and image wallpapers (optional sound), clock layouts, a glass card, Now Playing, battery and weather and a power button with Hibernate; the desktop's live wallpaper; and in the top bar Finder (round custom logo, 14-30 px), Places and the app indicator. Built on WACK Sonoma Lockscreen (rinzler69-wastaken, GPL-3.0) and Live Lock Screen (nick-redwill, AGPL-3.0); AGPL-3.0.
author: MehulK
